grh_501d65b575657cf0e925.title: Hired Wife
paragraphs: Cement-company owner Stephen Dexter faces a legal maneuver that could freeze his business and property. His lawyer suggests a technical escape: marry immediately, transfer everything to his wife, and divorce later. Stephen intends to marry glamorous Phyllis Walden, but his indispensable secretary Kendall Browning, who has long hidden her love for him behind strict efficiency, ends up becoming the temporary wife instead. Once Kendall controls the property, she proves far better at protecting the company than Stephen expected and refuses to surrender her new position on command. grh_5001acd2a2455fd566f6.title: Love Affair
paragraphs: Seeking an oil fortune in an oil-rich Saudi Arabian city, Harry meets nineteen-year-old American Marion and is quickly drawn into a romance while political and oil-concession intrigue swirls around him. When danger closes in, Harry helps Marion flee under false passports, traveling as husband and wife and treating the escape as his first marriage. Her large supply of cash makes the arrangement look even better to him. In Vienna, FBI agent George Harris catches them and reveals that Marion had shot and killed her wealthy husband at the hotel before attaching herself to Harry as a way out of the country. The serial numbers on the husband's recently cashed banknotes led authorities to her. Marion is taken back for trial, leaving Harry to admit that this time he was the one who had been used.

grh_50dcf8f14d08d845b644.title: Home Coming
paragraphs: Combat pilot Nicky returns to his wife Connie physically recovered but emotionally unable to bear being close to her, even though he knows he still loves her. Dr. Christian traces the estrangement to survivor's guilt over Nicky's wingman Skip, who died after Nicky's aircraft went out of control during their last combat. Nicky has convinced himself that if he had recovered control sooner he might have saved Skip, and a confused vision during his own crash has become proof in his mind that Connie would be better off without him. When Connie later appears to be in danger near a washed-out bridge, Nicky's immediate terror for her safety breaks through the emotional numbness. He finds her unharmed on the road, embraces her and finally accepts that his love for her never disappeared, a reunion Dr. Christian describes as another miracle worked by love.

paragraphs: Success-school promoter Rockingham Conway expects national publicity when small-town Tad Page wins his contest, only to discover that Tad is perfectly happy without ambition, status or wealth. Conway tries to remake him into a model graduate while secretary Claire Harris shows Tad the big city, but Tad's contentment exposes how artificial Conway's philosophy of success really is.
